questions.sql: SELECT t.group_name AS group_name, t.date_dir AS date_dir, AVG(t.escape_latency_s) AS escape_latency_s FROM (SELECT v.group_name AS group_name, v.mouse_id AS mouse_id, v.date_dir AS date_dir, AVG(m.value) AS escape_latency_s FROM trial_metrics AS m JOIN videos AS v ON v.video_id = m.video_id WHERE v.phase = 'training_day' AND m.metric = 'escape_latency_s' AND m.algo_version = 'v1-platformzone-46px-maskcontact-mount500ms' AND m.calc_status = 'ok' GROUP BY v.group_name, v.mouse_id, v.date_dir) AS t GROUP BY t.group_name, t.date_dir ORDER BY t.group_name, t.date_dir LIMIT 200

questions.sql: WITH mouse_day AS (SELECT v.group_name, v.mouse_id, v.date_dir, AVG(tm.value) AS latency FROM videos AS v JOIN trial_metrics AS tm ON tm.video_id = v.video_id WHERE v.phase = 'training' AND v.date_dir IN ('0804', '0808') AND tm.metric = 'escape_latency_s' AND tm.algo_version = 'v1-platformzone-46px-maskcontact-mount500ms' AND tm.calc_status = 'ok' GROUP BY v.group_name, v.mouse_id, v.date_dir), grp_day AS (SELECT group_name, date_dir, AVG(latency) AS grp_latency FROM mouse_day GROUP BY group_name, date_dir) SELECT d1.group_name, ROUND((d5.grp_latency - d1.grp_latency) / d1.grp_latency * 100, 2) AS escape_latency_s_change_pct FROM grp_day AS d1 JOIN grp_day AS d5 ON d5.group_name = d1.group_name AND d5.date_dir = '0808' WHERE d1.date_dir = '0804' ORDER BY d1.group_name LIMIT 200
